toys.name: COINS
toys.description: The standard spendable board currency.

toys.name: STARS
toys.description: The primary victory collectible.

toys.name: STANDARD DICE BLOCK
toys.description: Roll from 1 to 6 for normal movement.

toys.name: DOUBLE DICE BLOCK
toys.description: Roll two dice and move by their total.

toys.name: TRIPLE DICE BLOCK
toys.description: Roll three dice and move by their total.

toys.name: SLOW DICE BLOCK
toys.description: Choose a careful roll from 1 to 3.

toys.name: SUPER MUSHROOM
toys.description: Boost the player's next movement.

toys.name: WARP WHISTLE
toys.description: Warp to another board space.

toys.name: DUEL CARD
toys.description: Challenge another player to a duel.

toys.name: COIN BONUS CARD
toys.description: Gain a quick coin bonus.

toys.name: PARTY APPLE
toys.description: A small restorative snack.

toys.name: CELEBRATION CAKE
toys.description: A powerful treat that restores the whole party.

toys.name: HEART POTION
toys.description: Restore health or clear a minor injury.

toys.name: FIRST AID KIT
toys.description: Restore health and remove a negative status.
